attributes.action: Young men need to learn that respecting a woman’s boundaries isn’t optional.
attributes.background: Stronger education that teaches boys about respect, consent, healthy relationships, and accountability. Rather than placing the responsibility on girls to protect themselves from harmful male behaviour, we must prevent that behaviour by educating boys from young on boundaries and respect for women.

rejection.details:
Schools already teach boys about consent, respecting boundaries and challenging misogyny as part of statutory RSHE, and recent government updates have strengthened this further with explicit content on harmful online influences and respectful relationships.

https://www.gov.uk/government/news/vawg-strategy-to-better-protect-children-from-misogyny-and-abuse

We might be able to allow another petition if you explain exactly what changes you would like to make to the national curriculum.
